title: Air Fryer French Fries
description: Chef John's air fryer French fries recipe uses a cold and hot water trick that yields crispy fries that rival regular ones using a fraction of the oil.

steps.text: Cut each potato lengthwise into ⅜-inch-thick slices; cut slices into ⅜-inch-wide sticks. Place potato sticks in a bowl of cold water; soak to release excess starches, about 5 minutes. Drain.

Pour boiling water over potatoes until covered by a few inches; set aside for 10 minutes. Drain potatoes; transfer to some paper towels. Blot excess water from potatoes; cool completely, at least 10 minutes.
Place cooled potatoes in a bowl; drizzle with oil. Season with cayenne; toss to coat.
Preheat an air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Stack potatoes in a double layer in the air fryer basket.
Air fry for 15 minutes. Slide basket out; toss fries. Continue air frying until golden brown, about 10 minutes more. Transfer fries to a bowl; toss with salt. Serve immediately.

video.description: Grab some russet potatoes because it's time to master the art of air-fried French fries with Chef John by your side! To prep the perfect fries, he'll show you how to cut the potatoes properly before treating them to a shortcut soaking technique so you can get cooking right away. While the soaked sticks are drained and dried, you'll preheat the air fryer and season the sticks any way you like--John likes to save the salt for the end. See how to stack the sticks in the fryer basket and cook them, in 2 rounds, to golden brown perfection. Before you get air fryer amnesia, remember that these don't stay as crispy as long as regular fries, but having to gobble them up right away is a small price to pay! Get the recipe for [Air Fryer French Fries](https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/278581/air-fryer-french-fries/).
